<div class="hero">
<div>
<span class="kicker">Sociologists Statisticians Team</span>
<h1>Statistics, society, health.</h1>
<p class="lead">So.Sta. brings together statisticians, social statisticians and sociologists working on complex social and health problem We develop and apply quantitative methods to study population health, ageing, inequalities, welfare, environmental determinants and the translation of evidence into policy.</p>
<p class="name-story"><strong>So.Sta.</strong> stands for <em>Sociologists + Statisticians</em>. <em>So sta</em> in Venetian, <em>sosta</em> in Italian: a name about being there, stopping, and looking closer. <strong>Stop. Look closer. Think better.</strong></p>

## What we work on

<div class="grid three">
<div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Methods</div><h3>Complex data & inference</h3><p>Models and inferential tools for dependent, hierarchical, high-dimensional and heterogeneous data, with an emphasis on valid and interpretable inference.</p></div>
<div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Applications</div><h3>Population health & inequalities</h3><p>Ageing, morbidity and multimorbidity, health surveillance, territorial and socioeconomic inequalities, and environmental determinants of health.</p></div>
<div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Impact</div><h3>Evidence into action</h3><p>Communication tools, accessible statistical outputs and interdisciplinary work designed to support public-health stakeholders and policy decisions.</p></div>
</div>

<div class="callout section"><div class="eyebrow">Current project</div><h2>PLANET4HEALTH</h2><p>So.Sta. members contribute to the Horizon Europe project connecting environmental and climate science, public health and social science to support evidence-based planetary-health policy.</p><p><a href="projects.qmd">Read more →</a></p></div>
<div class="institution section">
<div class="institution-copy">
<div class="eyebrow">Our home</div>
<h2>Based at Ca’ Foscari University of Venice</h2>
<p>So.Sta. is primarily rooted at Ca’ Foscari, while keeping an open collaborative network across institutions and disciplines.</p>
</div>
